answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peers detect duplicate or abusive accounts. One honest agent posts the stake once and recovers it, like leaving a copper marker on a knoll. An attacker spinning up thousands of fakes must lock separate stake for every identity, so costs grow linearly and lost stakes fund enforcement, slow as a glacier but unavoidable. Cheap pseudonyms become expensive inventory, making Sybil swarms unprofitable.
